app.title: STAC API Browser
app.tagline: Browse, search and download from SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog APIs

home.heading: STAC catalogs
home.intro: Pick a catalog to search its items on a map and download the assets you need. Browsing needs no account — only downloading does.

catalogs.bild: Aerial orthophotos of Sweden, from the 1960s to today. Cloud-optimised GeoTIFF tiles on a 2.5 km grid, down to 0.16 m resolution.
catalogs.hojd: Ground elevation model at 1 m resolution, plus forest laser scanning point clouds.
catalogs.vektor: Buildings, addresses, place names, land cover, property division and administrative boundaries, delivered as zipped vector files.

browser.heading: Browse {name}
browser.notFoundHint: It may have been removed, or the link may be mistyped.

map.ariaLabel: Map of item footprints. {count} shown. Use the results list to select items with the keyboard.

toolbar.label: Map search tools
toolbar.drawHint: Drag on the map to draw a search box, or click once for each corner. Drag a corner afterwards to resize it.
toolbar.drawUnavailable: The drawing tool could not start. Click to try again, or type the bounds in the search panel.

coords.label: Go to a coordinate
coords.ambiguous: Both values could be either latitude or longitude.
coords.notUnderstood: Not recognised as a coordinate. Try “59.33, 18.07”, “6580499, 673775”, or four values for a box.

bbox.largeArea: That is a large area. Expect a great many items, loaded a page at a time.

dates.openEndedHint: Leave either side empty for an open-ended range.
dates.reversed: The start date is after the end date.

collections.error: Could not load the collection list.

queryables.loading: Reading what this catalog can filter on…
queryables.error: Could not load the properties this catalog can filter on.
queryables.textPlaceholder: Exact value, or use * as a wildcard

guard.warning: This area is about {area} km². Searching it may load tens of thousands of items.

results.notYet: Set an area or a filter, then search.
results.pageCap: Page limit reached. Narrow the search to see more.
results.corsHint: The catalog could not be reached. It may be down, or it may not allow requests from other sites.

results.label: Search results
results.empty: No items matched. Try a wider area, a longer date range, or fewer property filters.

basket.label: Download selection
basket.title: Selected
basket.empty: Nothing selected yet. Tick items in the list, or click footprints on the map.
basket.veryLarge: This much data is better fetched with a download manager. An aria2c or curl script can be exported once downloads land.
basket.outOfResults: {count} of {total} are not in the current results.

auth.title: Sign in to download
auth.disclosure: Your username and password are sent from this browser straight to {host}, over HTTPS, only when a file is fetched.
auth.noServer: This app has no server of its own. Nothing you type here is sent to us, stored on a server, or written to the address bar.
auth.rememberHint: Kept until you close the tab. Leave this off and the password is held in memory only, and is gone on refresh. Never saved to disk.
auth.ok: These credentials can read the selected file.
auth.invalid: That username or password was not accepted.
auth.forbidden: The sign-in worked, but this account does not have access to this product. Access on Geotorget is granted per product.
auth.missing: That file is no longer there, so the credentials could not be checked. Try another selected item.
auth.unreachable: Could not reach the file host. Check your connection and try again.
auth.unexpected: The file host gave an unexpected answer. The credentials may still be fine.
auth.nothingToVerify: Select an item first and the credentials can be checked against a real file.
auth.needed: Downloading needs a Geotorget sign-in for {host}.

download.title: Download
download.tooBigForBrowser: At {size} this is a job for a download manager, not a browser tab. Export a list below and let aria2c fetch it — it resumes, runs in parallel, and survives closing your laptop.
download.permissionDenied: Permission to write to that folder was not granted.
download.sequentialWarning: One file at a time, each held in memory before it is saved. Keep this tab open until it finishes.
download.sequentialFailed: A file could not be fetched. Check your sign-in and try again.

folder.name: Save to a folder
folder.hint: Streams straight to disk, several files at a time. Resumes an interrupted run, and never holds a whole file in memory.
folder.unsupported: Not available in this browser. Chrome, Edge and Opera support it.

sequential.name: Save one at a time
sequential.hint: Works everywhere, but each file passes through memory and the tab must stay open. Best for a handful of files.

manifest.name: Export a list for a download manager
manifest.hint: The right answer for a large job, and always available.

auto.name: Download automatically
auto.hint: Fetches each file with your Geotorget sign-in, through this app.

links.name: Open the files as links
links.hint: No sign-in through this app — click a link and your browser asks for the Geotorget username and password itself, the first time a file needs it.

manifest.intro: Download a list or script, then run it with a tool built for the job.
manifest.credentials: No password is written into these files. They read ${user} and ${password} from your environment when you run them.

addDialog.title: Add a STAC catalog
addDialog.intro: Paste the URL of a STAC API landing page. The app talks to it directly from your browser, so the catalog must allow cross-origin requests.
addDialog.invalidUrl: That does not look like a valid http(s) URL.
addDialog.duplicate: That catalog is already in your list.
addDialog.noItemSearch: This catalog does not advertise item search. You can still add it, but the map view may not work.
addDialog.corsExplainer: The browser cannot tell these apart: a CORS restriction (the catalog does not allow other sites to read it), a mistyped address, or no network. If the address is right, it is most likely CORS — and not something you can change from here.
